Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by the 10-year Treasury yield hitting 5% and lingering AI doomsday fears. This is a headwind for your concentrated tech/chip book.
Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are flagged for attention (SELL/TRIM). Their leveraged nature amplifies your drawdowns, especially on margin.
Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield and any further developments on AI sentiment.
Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and the overall tech sector sentiment.
plays: Trim SOXL: Given the SELL status and significant loss, consider reducing exposure to manage margin risk.
Trim SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is under pressure. Consider trimming to reduce risk.
Consider SOXS: Scanner shows a WATCH setup (9/12) with entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07. This is a bearish ETF, potentially a hedge.
